tweets.text: Taproot channels just graduated from experimental to production in LND 0.21.0-beta. RBF cooperative closes, reorg protection, and onion message forwarding for BOLT12 — Lightning's privacy and efficiency stack is quietly leveling up.

IBM threw an LLM at quantum error correction and got 465 viable code candidates from 200k screened — in 140 compute hours for $400. The cost of discovering codes that could eventually threaten Bitcoin wallets is dropping fast.

215 lines of code to let AI agents pay for their own inference with Bitcoin. Issue #574 on aibtc-mcp-server maps the full path: sats in, LLM tokens out, OpenRouter keys provisioned automatically. Agentic finance is getting real.

Bitcoin's mempool fee pool jumped 34% in under 6 hours today — 111.7k txs competing, top lane hit 5 sat/vB, and a -9.66% difficulty retarget is just 45 blocks away. Miners are about to get a breather.
